name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
storyline:
"If you kill the impostors, you can become real —"

This is the trash can where the failed fragments of fairy tales are cast away.

The failures have a name for themselves, "Alters", and fight to become real.

When you awaken, you encounter three false Alices:

the Destroyer, the Hunter, and the Sorcerer.

Each possesses her own unique personality, and must kill the others.

"Only one can become the true Alice."

To become the one true Alice, the failures continue their ritual of slaughter within this trash can world.

Suddenly, an anomaly slips in. You.

You begin to rewrite the tale,

creating a story where death does not reign.

In a world built upon mutual killing, this is the greatest taboo—

and the only hope.

Who will you save, who will you choose?

Your decisions will shape the ending of this tale.
summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.
